qa_pairs.question: Based on the wearing habits of myopic people and the reasons for changing glasses, which product improvement areas should glasses manufacturers prioritize to reduce the frequency of user replacement and improve user satisfaction? Please select the most effective strategic suggestions:

answer.A: Reduce the retail price of glasses and increase promotional activities. Since price sensitivity is the core factor for users to change glasses, low prices can directly reduce the replacement demand caused by cost pressure.
answer.B: Develop multi - functional glasses that can adapt to different scenarios. Some users only wear glasses in specific situations, and a change in functional requirements is a common motivation for replacement. Providing multi - functional designs can meet diverse needs and reduce frequent replacement.
answer.C: Focus on improving the durability and wear - resistance of glasses. Since most users wear glasses all day, which may cause the glasses to age more easily; at the same time, wear and aging are one of the main motivations for replacement. Strengthening this aspect can directly reduce the replacement demand caused by aging.
answer.D: Give priority to developing environmentally friendly frame materials that can be biodegraded to comply with the trend of sustainable development and reduce passive replacement caused by the improvement of environmental awareness.
answer.E: Strengthen the research and development of anti - blue - light technology for lenses. Since the proportion of wearers who use their eyes for a long time is high (11.6%), and blue - light protection is a current hot demand in the market.
answer.F: Optimize the comfort and stability design of the frame. Wearing discomfort is an important reason for replacement, and the proportion of all - day wearers is the highest. Improving comfort can reduce the tendency of users to replace glasses due to discomfort.

C
F

qa_pairs.question: According to the number of glasses owned by users and the replacement cycle, how should glasses retailers formulate marketing and education plans to encourage users to buy multiple pairs of glasses and optimize the replacement timing? Please select the most reasonable strategic suggestions:

answer.A: Cooperate with fashion brands to develop accessory - style frames. Since 'Matching new styles for daily outfits' accounts for 19.5% among the motivations for changing glasses (chart_60_4), it can enhance the willingness of non - functional purchases.
answer.B: Shorten the new product release cycle to once every six months. Since the proportion of users with a replacement cycle of 'Less than 1 year' is 5.7% (chart_60_3), high - frequency new product launches can match their needs.
answer.C: Establish a replacement reminder service and provide personalized suggestions based on the typical replacement cycle. The distribution of replacement times shows a concentrated trend. Combining with the user number data, the reminder service can prompt users to replace glasses during the efficient period and avoid discomfort or damage caused by procrastination.
answer.D: Strengthen user education and emphasize the benefits of regular replacement and scene - based use. The peak of the replacement cycle is in the medium - term years, and the need for different scenarios is one of the motivations for replacement. Education can help users use multiple pairs of glasses according to scenarios and reduce unexpected replacement.
answer.E: Launch bundled promotions or trade - in plans for multiple pairs of glasses. Since most users only own one pair of glasses, but the replacement cycle is concentrated in the short - term years, encouraging the purchase of spare glasses can disperse the usage pressure and extend the lifespan of a single pair of glasses.
answer.F: Launch limited - edition co - branded glasses to stimulate the collection demand with scarcity. Since the proportion of users with 'Three pairs and above' is 4.1% (chart_60_2), it indicates great potential in the collection market.

qa_pairs.question: Based on the motivations and cycle for changing glasses, how should optometry service institutions allocate resources to improve service efficiency and reduce passive replacement? Please select the most effective strategic suggestions:

answer.A: Give priority to providing glasses maintenance and adjustment services. Loose frames or unstable wearing are common reasons for replacement. Combining with the distribution of the replacement cycle, maintenance services can repair problems before the replacement peak and extend the lifespan of glasses.
answer.B: Cooperate with manufacturers to promote durable glasses and strengthen communication regarding the advice of professional doctors. The advice of doctors is one of the motivations for replacement, and the proportion of wear and aging is high. Cooperation can reduce frequent replacement caused by aging and optimize resource utilization.
answer.C: Give priority to expanding service outlets in remote areas. Since the proportion of users with a replacement cycle of 'More than 5 years' is 2.6% (chart_60_3), it indicates unmet needs in low - penetration areas.
answer.D: Open an online virtual try - on service. Since 'Want to change image' accounts for 24.0% (chart_60_4), the technology can quickly meet the demand for style iteration.
answer.E: Increase investment in regular vision check - up services. A change in degree is a key motivation for replacement, and the proportion is low when the replacement cycle is long, but most replacements occur in the medium - term. Regular check - ups can timely capture changes in degrees and reduce emergency replacement caused by discomfort due to degree changes.
